lines.text: Boats from Tiberias landed near the place of the bread, and the crowd took them to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
The crowd said their fathers ate manna in the wilderness, and Jesus said it was Moses who gave the true bread.

wrong_details.true: it was not Moses who gave

lines.text: Jesus said He is the bread of life, and whoever comes to Him will never hunger.
The Jews grumbled that they knew Jesus' father and mother, so they asked how He could say He came down from heaven.
Jesus said fathers who ate manna died, while the one who eats this bread lives forever, teaching in the temple in Capernaum.
